categories.name: صِفَاتُ عِبَادِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ فِي سُورَةِ الْفُرْقَانِ
categories.nameEn: Qualities of the Servants of the Most Merciful in Surah Al-Furqan

items.verse: إِلَّا مَن تَابَ وَءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ عَمَلًۭا صَـٰلِحًۭا فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ يُبَدِّلُ ٱللَّهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِمْ حَسَنَـٰتٍۢ ۗ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ غَفُورًۭا رَّحِيمًۭا
items.verseEn: Except for those who repent, believe and do righteous work. For them Allāh will replace their evil deeds with good. And ever is Allāh Forgiving and Merciful.

items.verse: وَمَن تَابَ وَعَمِلَ صَـٰلِحًۭا فَإِنَّهُۥ يَتُوبُ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ مَتَابًۭا
items.verseEn: And he who repents and does righteousness does indeed turn to Allāh with [accepted] repentance.

items.verse: وَٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ذُكِّرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ لَمْ يَخِرُّوا۟ عَلَيْهَا صُمًّۭا وَعُمْيَانًۭا
items.verseEn: And those who, when reminded of the verses of their Lord, do not fall upon them deaf and blind.
Abiding eternally therein. Good is the settlement and residence.

items.verse: إِن كُلُّ نَفْسٍۢ لَّمَّا عَلَيْهَا حَافِظٌۭ
items.verseEn: There is no soul but that it has over it a protector.
The Day when secrets will be put on trial,

items.verse: فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن قُوَّةٍۢ وَلَا نَاصِرٍۢ
items.verseEn: Then he [i.e., man] will have no power or any helper.
Indeed, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is a decisive statement,

categories.name: مُصْطَلَحَاتٌ اجْتِمَاعِيَّةٌ وَقَضَائِيَّةٌ فِي سُورَةِ النِّسَاءِ
categories.nameEn: Social and Judicial Terms in Surah An-Nisa

items.verse: ٱلرِّجَالُ قَوَّٰمُونَ عَلَى ٱلنِّسَآءِ بِمَا فَضَّلَ ٱللَّهُ بَعْضَهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍۢ وَبِمَآ أَنفَقُوا۟ مِنْ أَمْوَٰلِهِمْ ۚ فَٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتُ قَـٰنِتَـٰتٌ حَـٰفِظَـٰتٌۭ لِّلْغَيْبِ بِمَا حَفِظَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ وَٱلَّـٰتِى تَخَافُونَ نُشُوزَهُنَّ فَعِظُوهُنَّ وَٱهْجُرُوهُنَّ فِى ٱلْمَضَاجِعِ وَٱضْرِبُوهُنَّ ۖ فَإِنْ أَطَعْنَكُمْ فَلَا تَبْغُوا۟ عَلَيْهِنَّ سَبِيلًا ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ عَلِيًّۭا كَبِيرًۭا
items.verseEn: Men are in charge of women by [right of] what Allāh has given one over the other and what they spend [for maintenance] from their wealth. So righteous women are devoutly obedient, guarding in [the husband's] absence what Allāh would have them guard. But those [wives] from whom you fear arrogance - [first] advise them; [then if they persist], forsake them in bed; and [finally], strike them [lightly]. But if they obey you [once more], seek no means against them. Indeed, Allāh is ever Exalted and Grand.

items.verse: وَإِنْ خِفْتُمْ شِقَاقَ بَيْنِهِمَا فَٱبْعَثُوا۟ حَكَمًۭا مِّنْ أَهْلِهِۦ وَحَكَمًۭا مِّنْ أَهْلِهَآ إِن يُرِيدَآ إِصْلَـٰحًۭا يُوَفِّقِ ٱللَّهُ بَيْنَهُمَآ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ عَلِيمًا خَبِيرًۭا
items.verseEn: And if you fear dissension between the two, send an arbitrator from his people and an arbitrator from her people. If they both desire reconciliation, Allāh will cause it between them. Indeed, Allāh is ever Knowing and Aware.

items.verse: ۞ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ كُونُوا۟ قَوَّٰمِينَ بِٱلْقِسْطِ شُهَدَآءَ لِلَّهِ وَلَوْ عَلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِكُمْ أَوِ ٱلْوَٰلِدَيْنِ وَٱلْأَقْرَبِينَ ۚ إِن يَكُنْ غَنِيًّا أَوْ فَقِيرًۭا فَٱللَّهُ أَوْلَىٰ بِهِمَا ۖ فَلَا تَتَّبِعُوا۟ ٱلْهَوَىٰٓ أَن تَعْدِلُوا۟ ۚ وَإِن تَلْوُۥٓا۟ أَوْ تُعْرِضُوا۟ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرًۭا
items.verseEn: O you who have believed, be persistently standing firm in justice, witnesses for Allāh, even if it be against yourselves or parents and relatives. Whether one is rich or poor, Allāh is more worthy of both. So follow not [personal] inclination, lest you not be just. And if you distort [your testimony] or refuse [to give it], then indeed Allāh is ever, of what you do, Aware.

items.verse: فَلَا وَرَبِّكَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ حَتَّىٰ يُحَكِّمُوكَ فِيمَا شَجَرَ بَيْنَهُمْ ثُمَّ لَا يَجِدُوا۟ فِىٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ حَرَجًۭا مِّمَّا قَضَيْتَ وَيُسَلِّمُوا۟ تَسْلِيمًۭا
items.verseEn: But no, by your Lord, they will not [truly] believe until they make you, [O Muḥammad], judge concerning that over which they dispute among themselves and then find within themselves no discomfort from what you have judged and submit in [full, willing] submission.

categories.name: جُمُوعُ تَكْسِيرٍ عَلَى وَزْنِ فُعُولٍ
categories.nameEn: Quranic broken plurals on the pattern فُعُول

items.verse: سَنُلْقِى فِى قُلُوبِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ٱلرُّعْبَ بِمَآ أَشْرَكُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ مَا لَمْ يُنَزِّلْ بِهِۦ سُلْطَـٰنًۭا ۖ وَمَأْوَىٰهُمُ ٱلنَّارُ ۚ وَبِئْسَ مَثْوَى ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
items.verseEn: We will cast terror into the hearts of those who disbelieve for what they have associated with Allāh of which He had not sent down [any] authority. And their refuge will be the Fire, and wretched is the residence of the wrongdoers.
Indeed, the righteous will be among gardens and springs,

items.verse: فَتِلْكَ بُيُوتُهُمْ خَاوِيَةًۢ بِمَا ظَلَمُوٓا۟ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةًۭ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يَعْلَمُونَ
items.verseEn: So those are their houses, desolate because of the wrong they had done. Indeed in that is a sign for people who know.

items.verse: فَلَمَّا رَأَوْهُ زُلْفَةًۭ سِيٓـَٔتْ وُجُوهُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَقِيلَ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَدَّعُونَ
items.verseEn: But when they see it approaching, the faces of those who disbelieve will be distressed, and it will be said, "This is that for which you used to call."

harf.hint: A blazing destination for Pharaoh and those who deny truth
harf.arabicVerse: ۞ وَمَن يَقُلْ مِنْهُمْ إِنِّىٓ إِلَـٰهٌۭ مِّن دُونِهِۦ فَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِيهِ جَهَنَّمَ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
harf.verse: 21:29 - And whoever of them should say, "Indeed, I am a god besides Him" - that one We would recompense with Hell. Thus do We recompense the wrongdoers.

deduction.title: The Eleven Stars That Bowed
deduction.intro: A figure from the Quran was granted a profound vision in childhood — a dream of celestial bodies bowing in reverence. Years would pass through betrayal, separation, false accusation, and imprisonment before this vision came true. Who is this resilient soul whose story occupies the longest chapter of the Quran?
clues: I was once young, blessed with a remarkable dream that even my own father warned me to keep private.
My own brothers, blinded by jealousy, plotted against me and cast me into a deep, dark well.
I was carried to a distant land and sold into the household of a noble official, where I found favor and rose in responsibility.
False accusation led to my unjust imprisonment, yet in that dark place I found solace in prayer and prostration to Allah.
Allah blessed me with the rare ability to interpret dreams, which eventually brought me before the ruler of the land and elevated me to a high position of trust.
After long years of separation, I was reunited with my beloved family, and my childhood dream of eleven stars, the sun, and the moon bowing to me was finally fulfilled.

identity.label: Who Am I?
options: Prophet Yusuf
Prophet Salih
Prophet Ilyas
Tubba', the ruler of ancient Himyar
A humble shepherd from the hills of Palestine

trial.label: Trial/Event
options: Being cast into a deep, dark well by jealous brothers
Being swallowed by a great creature of the deep seas
Being thrown into a blazing fire by idolaters
Being swept away by a divine wind of destruction
Surviving a great flood that covered the entire land
trial.answer: Being cast into a deep, dark well by jealous brothers

location.label: Key Element
options: A dry well in the desert where I was abandoned
A great fish of the deep seas
A massive ark built upon divine command
A tower built to reach the heavens
A sacred fire that refused to burn
location.answer: A dry well in the desert where I was abandoned

outcome.label: Outcome
options: Reunited with family after years of separation and became a trusted minister
Led a great exodus of my people across a parted sea
Warned my nation of impending doom that consumed them
Built a sacred house that became a sanctuary for all
Emerged safely from the belly of a great creature after three days
outcome.answer: Reunited with family after years of separation and became a trusted minister

deduction.arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِى ٱشْتَرَىٰهُ مِن مِّصْرَ لِٱمْرَأَتِهِۦٓ أَكْرِمِى مَثْوَىٰهُ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَنفَعَنَآ أَوْ نَتَّخِذَهُۥ وَلَدًۭا ۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ مَكَّنَّا لِيُوسُفَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلِنُعَلِّمَهُۥ مِن تَأْوِيلِ ٱلْأَحَادِيثِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ غَالِبٌ عَلَىٰٓ أَمْرِهِۦ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
deduction.verse: And the one from Egypt who bought him said to his wife, "Make his residence comfortable. Perhaps he will benefit us, or we will adopt him as a son." And thus, We established Joseph in the land that We might teach him the interpretation of events [i.e., dreams]. And Allāh is predominant over His affair, but most of the people do not know. (12:21)

scramble.hint: A beautiful verse promising that those who have faith and do good works — the Most Merciful will place love (in the hearts of others) for them.
scramble.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ سَيَجْعَلُ لَهُمُ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ وُدًّۭا
scramble.verseEn: Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds - the Most Merciful will appoint for them affection.
